What it was for: [AI engineering](@/projects/ai.md) (1).

Most recently: [Majordomus](@/work/prismatic-majordomus.md): One policy for every AI coding tool, scoped tasks with a finish contract, a mesh for many sessions and machines, and an integration queue that lands only verified work. Local; it never invokes a model.

1 of these projects runs as a live site.
